title: Exec the commercial runtime from the core launcher on Unix
goal: Vision: V-18. Core's launcher started the Commercial Apps runtime as a child and waited, so a daemon started through susi ran under a different pid than the launcher: supervisors and tests that wait for ports.json naming the launcher pid never saw it (host_only_privacy, peer_channel_hub), and stopping the launcher left the runtime running. On Unix the launcher now replaces itself with the runtime (exec).
